tax: Assurance maladie universelle (CNAMU), employer contribution
statute: Loi n° 060-2015/CNT portant régime d'assurance maladie universelle; Décret n° 2018-0265 (CNAMU)
unsupported: the decree fixing the contribution rate was not located (press reports of Nov 2025 give 5 %, half each, with benefits from 1 February 2026; not a rate text); collection for the 2025 year not established
tried: CNSS Wayback listing (no AMU text); one web search

tax: Customs import duty (applied tariff, WTO IDB 2025)
statute: customs tariff of Burkina Faso as notified to the WTO IDB for 2025; WTO Integrated Database (IDB), applied tariff notified by Burkina Faso for 2025 (HS 2022), read on the WTO Tariff & Trade Data browse pages (ttd.wto.org/en/data/idb/applied-duties?member=C854&product=<line>&year=2025, retrieved 2026-11-21; customs/packs/bf.json)
unsupported: only the HS subheadings of customs/HS_MAP.md are modelled (any other code: grade C, no tariff line)
IDB notification year 2025: a change of the tariff during 2025 (budget measures, stays of application) is not dated
national import levies and charges outside the customs duty column (statistical, processing, ECOWAS/AU levies, import VAT advance) not modelled
the price is taken before VAT and duty only: an excise inside the price needs "customsValue"
WAEMU (UEMOA) customs union (origin BJ, CI, GW, ML, NE, SN, TG): internal preference not in the member's 2025 IDB notification, rate not read (grade C)
